# Browser dependencies

Vendored from the same official/CDN distributions previously loaded by index.html so on-site offline preparation can cache same-origin files. Embedded license notices are retained. These browser artifacts are committed; builds do not fetch floating CDN dependencies.

- qrcode.min.js: qrcodejs 1.0.0, https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js (MIT).
- jszip.min.js: JSZip 3.10.1, https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jszip@3.10.1/dist/jszip.min.js (MIT/GPLv3 dual license).
- xlsx.full.min.js: SheetJS CE 0.20.3, https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js (Apache-2.0).
- supabase.js: captured @supabase/supabase-js 2.x UMD distribution, https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2/dist/umd/supabase.js (MIT).
